title: The Gilded Wolf
author: Kestrel Nystrom
blurb: Juniper Thackeray, a bone-carver who hears the dead, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the long winter finishes falling.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
